tool_args.rationale: The discriminating probe supplies wide s_grad leverage needed to distinguish the open branch and identify the siphon parameters. Subsequent fitting should use the full wide fallback bounds rather than the narrow warm-start box.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon model on the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad range leaves vmax and rho nearly collinear, so predictions across a wider gradient range are not identifiable.
The relevant ambiguity is gradient leverage and branch selection, not temporal resolution; this probe also costs more.
The pilot is monotone increasing and concave, with no observed high-substrate decline.
